'''Maddox the Slayer''' is an [[NPC]] located at the {{Zone|Stillgore Chateau}} in the [[Rift Dimension|Rift]]. The player can start a [[Slayer]] quest after speaking to '''Maddox the Slayer''' and paying {{Motes}}. The player can access '''Maddox the Slayer''' from anywhere within the [[Rift Dimension|Rift]] by using the {{Item|Maddox Badphone}} once reaching {{CollectionLink|Vampire Slayer II}}.

== Trivia ==
*'''Maddox's''' dialogue regarding inter-dimensional travel implies both {{NPCSprite|Maddox the Slayer (Rift);'''Maddox the Slayer'''}} and his hub's counterpart {{NPCSprite|Maddox}} are the same entity. 
**This is makes {{NPCSprite|Maddox the Slayer (Rift);'''Maddox the Slayer'''}} one of the few [[NPC]]'s able to traverse between the [[Rift Dimension|Rift]] and the [[SkyBlock|Overworld]].
*'''Maddox's''' dialogue "... believe it or not, right to jail." is a reference to the iconic "Right to Jail"<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eiyfwZVAzGw</ref> monologue in Parks and Recreation Season 2 Episode 5 titled Sister City.<ref>https://www.imdb.com/title/tt1504148/</ref>
